dataFlow.before: When IndexedDB cache (all) or filtered inbound queue (inbounds) was empty, the component queried the legacy, in-memory tripEngineService.getAllTrips() to populate the queues.
dataFlow.after: Component reads strictly from IndexedDB cache and remote Firestore. If the cache is empty, the queue and search source remain empty. No legacy fallback is queried.

emptyStateAcceptance.emptyCanonicalCache: Empty incoming queue and empty search source
emptyStateAcceptance.nonemptyCacheWithZeroIncomingMatches: Incoming queue stays empty, search source remains cached
emptyStateAcceptance.cacheReadFailure: Handled as empty with no legacy fallback queried

projectScopeAndAuthorization.authorization: Preserved. Restricted to scale operators, site supervisors, supervisors, project admins, and super admins. [ACTUAL]
projectScopeAndAuthorization.projectFilteringLimits: Scoping by project via listByProject filters remote responses during sync but does not enforce project filtering on all local IndexedDB table reads. A distinction is maintained between an empty local cache and an empty remote response with a retained local cache. [ACTUAL]

outboxAndFSMPreservation.outboxBehavior: Unchanged. Enqueues status updates and weights atomically as JS object structures in outboxService. Does not make formal database-level transaction guarantees. [ACTUAL]
